subject.title: Feishu WebSocket should not inherit ambient proxy env by default

question: Should Feishu WebSocket switch from ambient-proxy-by-default to direct-by-default with an explicit proxy opt-in?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix changes upgrade behavior and proxy-based egress expectations for existing deployments, which is a security and product-default choice rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Finish Direct Default
options.body: Land the linked direct-by-default fix only after docs, real transport proof, test cleanup, and explicit maintainer acceptance of the egress-policy change.

options.title: Preserve Ambient Default
options.body: Keep ambient proxy inheritance as the default and add an explicit Feishu direct/bypass mode if existing proxy-required deployments should remain unchanged on upgrade.

options.title: Defer To Broader Proxy Policy
options.body: Hold this issue until the Feishu HTTP and per-channel proxy policy work settles a single channel-level routing model.

recommendation.title: Finish Direct Default
recommendation.body: Land the linked direct-by-default fix only after docs, real transport proof, test cleanup, and explicit maintainer acceptance of the egress-policy change.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata points to this handle as the Feishu/Lark channel plugin routing candidate for deciding the plugin-owned egress default.
